content:
We are seeking an accomplished Senior Technical Business Analyst with a minimum of 10+ years of professional business analysis experience and proven domain expertise supporting Life Sciences enterprise clients.

Role: Technical Business Analyst (Senior Level)
Location: Philadelphia, PA (Hybrid) Local Candidates Only
Position Type: Contract
Interview Mode: Video Interview
Experience Level: 10+ Years Required
Visa: NO H1B CPT

NOTE: MUST HAVE WORKING EXPRIENCE WITH LIFE SCIENCES CLIENT

Required Qualifications
10+ years of progressive Business Analysis experience in large, complex enterprise environments.
Mandatory Life Sciences Domain Experience: Prior background working with pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device clients.
Advanced DMN & BPMN Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on expertise building DMN decision models (FEEL expressions, BKMs, DRDs) and BPMN 2.0 process flows.
Business Rules Governance: Proven track record designing or operating formal rules governance and lifecycle management frameworks.
Agile Expertise: Mastery of user story development, backlog grooming, and acceptance criteria definition.
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional facilitation, analytical, and communication skills across executive, functional, and technical teams.

Please submit your updated resume and project portfolio highlighting your DMN/BPMN and Life Sciences background at abhay@sourceinfotech.com
